set.body:
Owner directive (2026-09-02): "this is research, let's not sweat the license for now", closing the weights-licence leaf of the captioning admission record for local research use. Realize the 4B local captioning court under ledger §6.3.

What lands
- media/worker-vlm: uv-locked Python project (mlx-vlm 0.6.17, mlx 0.32.2, huggingface-hub, numpy, pillow, jinja2; CPython 3.13.11) and caption_worker.py, an untrusted worker that verifies the local model directory against the request's shard digests, verifies the frame file digest, presents each extent's frames as an image sequence with one fixed prompt, decodes greedily, and writes text plus what the processor applied (prompt digest, pixel limits, patch/temporal/merge sizes, mean/std, per-extent image grid). Offline (HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1). It never opens a container and never computes a timestamp.
- Weights: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct at revision ebb281ec70b0 fetched into the ignored tmp/models/ and verified: both shards equal the repository's LFS digests (30a01a05…, 046296a2…); config.json sha256 edac7703…. Not committed.
- media (ADR 0007 amendment 2026-09-02): ModelPin, CaptionRecipe, CaptionExtent, CaptionRequest, CaptionOutcome, AppliedCaptionRecipe, CaptionResult, ModelEcho, CaptionEnvelope, CaptionProposal, CaptionSearch/CaptionSearchResult, WorkerRealization.observeCaption. The join reuses the boundary court's identity-edit-list guard and refuses on request/frames/recipe/model/runtime mismatch, unverified shards, applied recipe not satisfying the declared one, partial coverage, a result not answering its extent, or an extent that cannot be closed on the axis. Proposals are Draft, carry recipe and model identities, and are not TimedSegments.
- Recorded F0 run: three extents sampling the three declared shots; captions "solid red screen", "solid green screen", "deep blue screen" (proposals, not truth); supports [0,16000), [16000,32000), [32000,48000) from the packet index; two worker runs byte-identical; outcome sha256 c2f69ccb…; worker script sha256 86ef031a….
- Courts (CaptionSearchSuite, 7): replay into three draft proposals with the right supports and identities; replay identity and derivation distinctness; refusals for request-id, frames, recipe, model revision, unverified shards, runtime, request-describes; applied/coverage/extent refusals; extent construction and issue refusals; proposal-is-not-a-segment; live court running the worker over the verified weights (ran here: same text under the same worker).
- Docs: captioning record §3 owner decision and §10 realization; ledger §6.3 gate closed, registry rows and §6.2 rows for the 4B weights and the worker venv.

Not established
- Anything about what F0 or any film shows: the captions are one model's greedy output for one prompt; F0's colours are generator ground truth for the plumbing only. No F1 or Sherlock captioning yet; no calibration arm has run; no adapter from CaptionProposal to TimedSegment exists. The worker trusts mlx-vlm's processor read-back for `applied`; the interpreter and wheel bytes are not hashed (script only); the image grid is recorded but not compared. The 8B calibration arm is nominated but not realized (disk: 13 GiB free after the 4B download).
set.title: Captioning lane: realize the Qwen3-VL-4B local court (worker, verified weights, caption proposals join, F0 recorded run)
